summary.intent: Execute all 9 plans of GSD phase 71 (Share-Invite Security & IPNS Data-Integrity API) via wave-based parallel subagent orchestration, then run a fully autonomous 'ship phase' loop (verify/secure/validate/simplify/SDK-E2E/CodeRabbit/ship/resolve-reviews/extract-learnings) to get it into a mergeable PR without babysitting.
summary.outcome: All 9 plans executed across 4 waves and merged, verification passed (16/16 truths, 0 gaps). Ship loop completed verify/secure/validate/simplify, ran the SDK E2E gate which caught and fixed a real D-05 regression (400 vs expected 409 on concurrent CAS race), triaged CodeRabbit CLI findings, opened PR #599 with a conventional title, and found+fixed a Greptile P1 bug (stale write key after generation-bump re-claim) during PR review resolution; transcript ends mid-poll on final CI settle and learnings extraction.

repo: cipher-box is a pnpm monorepo; `pnpm typecheck` (root script) is the authoritative cross-plan/CI-gated check, but it excludes `apps/api tsc --noEmit`, so errors there are non-gating and can be pre-existing noise

Repo uses squash-merge only (merge:false, rebase:false, squash:true) — individual commit subjects never reach main, only the PR title needs to be conventional/paren-free; per-commit reword is unnecessary
`gh pr edit` fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL; PR body must be patched via `gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file`
Live dev stack ports: postgres 5432, kubo 5001, redis 6380, mock-ipns-routing 3001, tee-worker 3002 (health 200 but /public-key can 401 after a DB reset, breaking tee_key_state sync)
sdk-e2e reads `SDK_E2E_SECRET` (vitest does not auto-load .env); must be manually aligned with the API's `TEST_LOGIN_SECRET` or auth 401s cascade-skip entire suites
Throttle limits are relaxed automatically under `NODE_ENV=test`, so `THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET` is not required for sdk-e2e runs against a test-mode API
A stale `node dist/main.js` process left running on :3000 will not reflect current branch code — must be killed and restarted from a fresh build/watch before trusting any live-stack test result
.env files are gitignored, so a freshly created worktree needs them copied in manually before running e2e suites
CodeRabbit CLI review skips diffs over 150 changed files; phase 71's 106 files stayed under the cap
The GSD commit-tracking helper has a recurring false-negative: it reports `commit_failed` even when `git log` shows the commit landed — always verify via git log, never blindly retry

code.finding: D-05 same-seq CID-equivocation guard threw 400 whenever embeddedSeq===dbSeq with a different CID, but this also fires on a legitimate forward-CAS attempt that lost a race (client sent expectedSequenceNumber=embeddedSeq-1); fix must let that case fall through to the CAS UPDATE for a proper 409 instead of a false 400

Widen-only merge (71-07) failed to rewrap the write key on a generation bump when the share was already write-capable but the invite triggering the bump was also write-capable (isGenerationBump && inviteGrantsWrite but isWriteUpgrade=false) — encryptedWriteKey stayed wrapped for the old generation, silently breaking recipient write access post-rotation (Greptile P1 finding)

Permission-derivation used `writeDescriptorRef/encryptedWriteKey !== null`, misclassifying an `undefined` value (DTO type is string|null|undefined) as write-capable; loosened to `!= null` in both occurrences

workflow: Scope each wave's post-merge gate to what actually reached a consistent state (e.g. skip full typecheck in Wave 1 when consumers are intentionally left broken until Wave 2) rather than running a blanket check that would false-fail by design
Never trust a subagent's 'tests pass' claim over conflicting compiler diagnostics — re-verify against the actual merged tree before deciding a finding is stale/noise
To find the real reason behind a handled 4xx the API doesn't log, temporarily add an axios response interceptor in the api-client instance, rebuild the chain, reproduce, then revert

Triage rule for autonomous review loops: in-scope + low-risk → fix immediately with a test; pre-existing/out-of-domain/risky-behavior-change → defer to a dated todo file with a clear rationale, never silently skip or silently fix

friction: A 71-03 Rust diagnostic (E0560 in delete.rs/rename.rs) initially looked like a real compile break but was stale LSP noise from an intermediate worktree state — required a full `cargo check --all-targets` on the merged tree to settle
Wave 3a's reported 'ipns.service.ts null-narrowing errors' turned out to be a crypto/dist staleness cascade, not real errors, once dist was rebuilt
sdk-e2e secret misalignment (SDK_E2E_SECRET default vs API's TEST_LOGIN_SECRET) caused an early-suite 401 that cascade-skipped Test 21 and leaked the test-name filter into an unrelated suite
First PR-review polling script had an awk parsing bug (tab-delimited gh output split on 'CodeRabbit / Review' spaces), causing a false read of pending/settled status
The orchestrator's own DB reset (done to validate 71-05's live checkpoint) wiped tee_key_state, causing 2 unrelated tee-republish test failures during the later SDK E2E ship gate
AUTO_MODE was enabled but phase 72 had no CONTEXT.md yet, forcing an explicit stop-and-ask rather than silent auto-advance
